shot.evalJs: __slope.progression.setLevel(4);(()=>{const S=__slope.sim,L=S.lifts.all();const line=(a,b)=>{const n=Math.max(Math.abs(b.x-a.x),Math.abs(b.y-a.y),1);return Array.from({length:n+1},(_,i)=>({x:Math.round(a.x+(b.x-a.x)*i/n),y:Math.round(a.y+(b.y-a.y)*i/n)}))};const fat=(p)=>{const m=new Map();for(const t of p)for(const [dx,dy] of [[0,0],[1,0],[0,1],[1,1]])m.set((t.x+dx)+','+(t.y+dy),{x:t.x+dx,y:t.y+dy});return [...m.values()]};let tot=0;L.forEach((l,k)=>{const t=l.top,b=l.bottom,dx=b.x-t.x,dy=b.y-t.y,len=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1,nx=-dy/len,ny=dx/len;(k==0?[[-4,1],[9,2]]:[[-4,3]]).forEach(([o,d],j)=>{const a={x:Math.round(t.x+1+nx*o),y:Math.round(t.y+1+ny*o)},c={x:Math.round(b.x+1+nx*o),y:Math.round(b.y+1+ny*o)};const pts=[...line({x:t.x+1,y:t.y+1},a),...line(a,c),...line(c,{x:b.x+1,y:b.y+1})];const r=S.networks.paint(1,fat(pts),d);tot+=r.painted});});console.log('RUNS painted',tot);const l0=L[0],c=__slope.renderer.controls,x=(l0.bottom.x+l0.top.x)/2,z=(l0.bottom.y+l0.top.y)/2;c.target.set(x,__slope.grid.getCorner(Math.round(x),Math.round(z))*0.5,z);})();setTimeout(()=>document.querySelectorAll('st-recap').forEach(e=>{e.style.display='none'}),300);setInterval(()=>document.querySelectorAll('st-toast').forEach(e=>{e.style.display='none'}),200)

shot.evalJs: (()=>{const S=__slope.sim,L=S.lifts.all();const line=(a,b)=>{const n=Math.max(Math.abs(b.x-a.x),Math.abs(b.y-a.y),1);return Array.from({length:n+1},(_,i)=>({x:Math.round(a.x+(b.x-a.x)*i/n),y:Math.round(a.y+(b.y-a.y)*i/n)}))};const fat=(p)=>{const m=new Map();for(const t of p)for(const [dx,dy] of [[0,0],[1,0],[0,1],[1,1]])m.set((t.x+dx)+','+(t.y+dy),{x:t.x+dx,y:t.y+dy});return [...m.values()]};let tot=0;L.forEach((l,k)=>{const t=l.top,b=l.bottom,dx=b.x-t.x,dy=b.y-t.y,len=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1,nx=-dy/len,ny=dx/len;(k==0?[[-4,1],[9,2]]:[[-4,3]]).forEach(([o,d],j)=>{const a={x:Math.round(t.x+1+nx*o),y:Math.round(t.y+1+ny*o)},c={x:Math.round(b.x+1+nx*o),y:Math.round(b.y+1+ny*o)};const pts=[...line({x:t.x+1,y:t.y+1},a),...line(a,c),...line(c,{x:b.x+1,y:b.y+1})];const r=S.networks.paint(1,fat(pts),d);tot+=r.painted});});console.log('RUNS painted',tot);const l0=L[0],c=__slope.renderer.controls,x=(l0.bottom.x+l0.top.x)/2,z=(l0.bottom.y+l0.top.y)/2;c.target.set(x,__slope.grid.getCorner(Math.round(x),Math.round(z))*0.5,z);})();__slope.setOverlay('runs');setTimeout(()=>document.querySelectorAll('st-recap').forEach(e=>{e.style.display='none'}),300);setInterval(()=>document.querySelectorAll('st-toast').forEach(e=>{e.style.display='none'}),200)

shot.pre: (async()=>{const s=__slope,n=s.sim.networks;const N=await new Function('u','return import(u)')('/src/world/Networks.ts');const {NetKind}=N;s.populateDemo('medium');s.progression.setLevel(4);const pts=[];for(let y=0;y<256;y+=2)for(let x=0;x<256;x+=2){const k=n.kindAt(x,y);if(k===NetKind.Path||k===NetKind.Road)pts.push({x,y});}let done=false;for(const p of pts){if(done)break;for(let dy=-4;dy<=4&&!done;dy+=1)for(let dx=-5;dx<=5&&!done;dx+=1){const o=s.debugPlace('ecoCentre',p.x+dx,p.y+dy,0,true);if(!o.ok)continue;if(s.sim.eco.enabled){done=true;console.info('EN '+(p.x+dx)+','+(p.y+dy));s.sim.eco.start('smartSnow');s.sim.eco.start('localProduce');}else s.sim.buildings.remove(o.building.id);}}console.info('pts '+pts.length+' done '+done);})();

shot.pre: (async()=>{const s=__slope,sim=s.sim;sim.progression.bypass++;const ok=s.riverDebug.dig(90,57);sim.progression.bypass--;const rec=sim.rivers.rivers[0];const P=rec.path;const m=P[P.length>>1];const c=s.renderer.controls;c.target.set(m.x+0.5,s.grid.getCorner(m.x,m.y)*0.5,m.y+0.5);const u=document.getElementById('ui');if(u)u.style.display='none';return JSON.stringify({ok,len:P.length,cls:P.map(q=>{const t=sim.flow.tileAt(q.x,q.y);return t?t.way.cls[t.i]:-1}).join(''),frozen:sim.flow.frozen})})()

shot.pre: (async()=>{const s=__slope,sim=s.sim;sim.progression.bypass++;const ok=s.riverDebug.dig(90,57);sim.progression.bypass--;const rec=sim.rivers.rivers[0];const P=rec.path;const m=P[P.length>>1];sim.jumpToDay(140,11);for(let k=0;k<400;k++)s.loop.advance(1);const c=s.renderer.controls;c.target.set(m.x+0.5,s.grid.getCorner(m.x,m.y)*0.5,m.y+0.5);const u=document.getElementById('ui');if(u)u.style.display='none';return JSON.stringify({ok,len:P.length,cls:P.map(q=>{const t=sim.flow.tileAt(q.x,q.y);return t?t.way.cls[t.i]:-1}).join(''),frozen:sim.flow.frozen})})()
